## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: shallow sector participation (Energy, Utilities, Industrials positive while most others weak) and narrow leadership concentration in Utilities/Industrials, with major tech divergences (AAPL/MSFT/META showing short‑term pullbacks vs NVDA/AMD strength).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy lead: XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%), OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.36% | 1M: +10.28%), COP ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.52% | 1M: +9.30%). Utilities: VST ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%), CEG ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.46% | 1M: +1.98%). Industrials: LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%), HON ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +5.60%), RTX ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.61% | 1M: +12.22%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Technology weak: GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%), AAPL CORRECTION (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +9.30%), MSFT CORRECTION (1W: -4.87% | 1M: +2.04%). Communication weak: CMCSA BELOW TREND (1W: -9.05% | 1M: -2.55%), TMUS BELOW TREND (1W: -11.63% | 1M: -7.67%). Consumer Discretionary weak: TSLA BELOW TREND (1W: -18.25% | 1M: -16.23%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: VST ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%), LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%), CEG ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.46% | 1M: +1.98%), HON ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +5.60%), FCX RECOVERY (1W: +8.44% | 1M: -1.16%). Leadership: Narrow (4/5 from Utilities & Industrials) — cyclical/value tilt.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: META CORRECTION (1W: -8.79% | 1M: +7.81%), CMCSA BELOW TREND (1W: -9.05% | 1M: -2.55%), CRM CORRECTION (1W: -9.12% | 1M: +2.29%), ADBE CORRECTION (1W: -9.83% | 1M: +7.47%), GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%). Weakness concentrated in high‑multiple Technology and Communication names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W movers: VST (1W: +10.76%), LMT (1W: +10.72%), CEG (1W: +9.46%), HON (1W: +8.81%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.74% | 1M: +3.82%). Note MAJOR divergence across large caps (AAPL, MSFT, META show 1W ≠ 1M patterns) — watch for trend breaks; treat moves as tactical rather than broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed, leaning negative near term: NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +4.36%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.74% | 1M: +3.82%), AAPL CORRECTION (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +9.30%), MSFT CORRECTION (1W: -4.87% | 1M: +2.04%), GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%). Sector breadth: Technology: 6/24 positive (internal rotation).

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Mixed to soft: JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.97% | 1M: +5.19%) but the sector is down week‑over‑week overall. Select banks showing strength but breadth muted; Financials: 7/20 positive (internal rotation).

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Cautious/patchy: JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.72% | 1M: +8.44%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.04% | 1M: +3.50%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.43% | 1M: +7.12%). Sector breadth: Healthcare: 6/17 positive (internal rotation).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor exposure toward cyclical/value names showing leadership (LMT, HON, XOM, RTX) and reduce exposure to names exhibiting short‑term CORRECTION (AAPL, MSFT, META) until breadth improves; style: Value/Cyclical tilt while market remains NEUTRAL. Monitor major‑cap divergences — treat tech weakness as tactical not definitive.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) — momentum confirmed; LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) — earnings/automation catalyst.  
BEARISH: GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) — downside follow‑through risk; TSLA BELOW TREND (1W: -18.25% | 1M: -16.23%) — high tail risk.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (Energy: 8/10 positive) and Industrials (Industrials: 10/15 positive) for continuation.  
BEARISH: Technology (Technology: 6/24 positive) and Communication (Communication: 2/10 positive) for further weakness if megacap selling continues.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
XOM 1W strength to sustain ABOVE TREND continuation if it holds 1M gains; NVDA above‑trend support to watch near recent pullback (monitor 1W momentum); AAPL CORRECTION — watch 1M trend support around recent consolidation; GOOGL BELOW TREND — watch for lower‑low confirmation on continued selling.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
RTX (+55): RTX ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.61% | 1M: +12.22%) — Q2 beat and raised outlook; price confirming sentiment (accumulation).  
SO (+60): SO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +1.90%) — long‑term power deal news supports Utilities outperformance; price confirming.  
AVGO (+60): AVGO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +5.50%) — Broadcom/Samsung supply win cited; price showing follow‑through (confirming).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
ORCL (-85): ORCL CORRECTION (1W: -3.20% | 1M: +2.10%) — headline pressure; price diverging from longer monthly strength, watch for distribution.  
WBD (-80): WBD BELOW TREND (1W: -4.50% | 1M: -6.00%) — headline risk; price confirming negative sentiment.  
IBM (-40): IBM CORRECTION (1W: -2.50% | 1M: +1.80%) — sentiment negative and short‑term weakness visible.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt given narrow leadership in Utilities/Industrials. XOM ABOVE TREND, LMT ABOVE TREND and RTX ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while AAPL CORRECTION, MSFT CORRECTION and GOOGL BELOW TREND show tech divergences. Key risk: major‑cap divergence and thin sector participation (Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive) — monitor news‑driven catalysts for follow‑through.
